short_description:
Three GTA history questions. 1: Grand Theft Auto started at DMA Design as "Race'n'Chase". 2: Vice City first appeared in the original GTA (1997), next to Liberty City and San Andreas. 3: Ray Liotta voiced Tommy Vercetti in GTA Vice City (2002). Comment your score!

Sources: GamesRadar (The making of Grand Theft Auto), Escapist, Engadget (Race'n'Chase design docs), GameSpot (The History of Grand Theft Auto), Wikipedia, IMDb.
